info.text:
Bank of America paid an average 0.51% on consumer deposits, checking included.
On Oct 14, 2026, it reported $16.4B in Q3 net interest income, up 8%.
Its consumer deposits averaged $949B, with an average rate paid of 0.51% in Q3 2026 (all consumer deposits, not a savings offer).
The Fed's target range is 3.75%-4.00% after the September 2026 hike.
Sources: Bank of America Q3 2026 earnings release and presentation, 10-Q filings; Federal Reserve statement, Sept 16, 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
